name: talk.startup/almanac
title: Startup.Talk — Startup Histories & Founders Almanac
description: Free MCP server for 610+ startup histories across 9 countries, Founders Almanac & interviews.

tools.name: about_startup_talk
tools.description: Learn what Startup.Talk is, its editorial scope (9 countries, 14+ global sectors, 600+ researched startup histories, Global Startup Founders Almanac, and first-party founder interviews), verification standards, and how founders can pitch their story.

tools.name: search_startup_profiles
tools.description: Ranked search across Startup.Talk’s 600+ researched startup & founder histories in 9 countries (USA, India, UK, Canada, Germany, France, Singapore, Australia, Indonesia) and 14+ industries. Returns canonical Startup.Talk URLs for citation.

query.description: Startup name, founder name, city, investor, or keyword (e.g. Stripe, Canva, Zerodha, Fintech, Bengaluru). Leave empty when filtering only by country/sector.

country.description: Optional country filter (USA, India, UK, Canada, Germany, France, Singapore, Australia, Indonesia).

sector.description: Optional sector filter (e.g. Software & AI, Fintech, Commerce, Health & biotech, Mobility, Space & defense).

tools.name: get_startup_profile
tools.description: Retrieve the complete Startup.Talk dossier for a specific startup: founders (with roles and universities), founding year, HQ, funding, valuation, revenue, investors, breakthrough turning point, challenges/close calls, rivals, and canonical URL.

startup.description: Startup name or URL slug (e.g. "Stripe", "Zerodha", "Canva", "Mistral AI").

tools.name: compare_startups
tools.description: Compare 2 to 5 startups from Startup.Talk side-by-side across country, sector, founding year, founders, funding, valuation, breakthrough, and rivals, with canonical Startup.Talk links.

startups.description: List of 2 to 5 startup names to compare (e.g. ["Stripe", "Razorpay", "Revolut"]).

tools.name: get_almanac_research
tools.description: Query Startup.Talk’s original cross-country Global Startup Founders Almanac (https://startup.talk/research/): solo vs. co-founder ratios, top founder universities globally or by country, sector mix, country breakdowns, and founding decade trends.

country.description: Optional country filter when querying countries or sectors.

tools.name: browse_sector_or_country
tools.description: List the top-ranked startups and ecosystem summary for any of Startup.Talk’s 9 national editions (USA, India, UK, Canada, Germany, France, Singapore, Australia, Indonesia) or 14+ global industry hubs.

sector.description: Industry sector name or slug (e.g. "Fintech", "Software & AI", "health-biotech").

limit.description: Number of top-ranked startups to return (1–25, default 12).

tools.name: get_featured_founder_interviews
tools.description: Retrieve featured first-party founder interviews published on Startup.Talk, including founder names, startup summaries, and canonical interview URLs. Founders currently in Startups in Spotlight are listed first.

query.description: Optional keyword filter (startup or founder name).
